title: Northwind Outfitters: October performance review
headline: Ada resolved 6 in 10 conversations on its own in October, and order changes are the next big win.
lead: Customers asked mostly about where their order was. Ada answered those from live order data. The next gain is *changing* an order, which still goes to your team.

metrics.label: Automated resolution
metrics.note: Conversations Ada resolved with no person.

metrics.label: Customer satisfaction
metrics.note: Of customers who answered the survey.

sections.title: What customers asked about
sections.intro: Four topics make up most of the volume. Order status is already well automated; order changes are not.

sections.title: Ada in your customers' words
sections.intro: Two real conversations, lightly masked: one that went well, and one that shows the next opportunity.

transcripts.title: Where is my order?
transcripts.why_shown: Shows a lookup answered with the customer's *own* order data.

turns.text: hey where's my jacket, ordered last week
Happy to check. What's your order number?
Thanks. Your jacket left our warehouse yesterday and should arrive by Thursday. Want the tracking link?

moment.label: Checked the order in your system

turns.text: Here you go: the tracking page shows each stop. Anything else I can help with?

transcripts.title: Change my delivery address
transcripts.why_shown: A change Ada could handle with one more connection.

turns.text: I need to change the address on my order, I'm moving
I can see order NW-51002 hasn't shipped yet. I'll pass you to a teammate who can update the address, with your order details so you don't repeat yourself.
You're now with Priya on our team.

moment.label: Passed to a person with the details

opportunities.title: Let Ada change an order's address
opportunities.why: 15% of conversations are order changes and Ada resolves 21% of them. Most start before the order ships, so Ada can finish them end to end.

opportunities.title: Show return labels in the chat
opportunities.why: Returns are 22% of volume. Customers ask for the label and then wait for a person to send it.

next_steps: Agree which order changes Ada should finish alone, such as address and size swaps.
Review ten *Change an order* conversations together to confirm the rules.
